idea-plugin.name: Outlook Email HTML Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Classic Outlook renders with the Word engine, the new Outlook with WebView2. Lint one email file against both at once, line by line, before you send.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Outlook Email HTML Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 33 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/outlook-email-html-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/outlook-email-html-lint

action.text: Outlook Email HTML Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Outlook Email HTML Lint on the file in the editor
